responsive_policy: Keep the existing767px width rule, plus touch-first (primary coarse pointer and no hover) screens up to600px tall. Do not classify wide fine-pointer desktops as mobile just because their window is short.

handedness.release: Commit opposite edge once peak inward horizontal travel reaches12 CSSpx. No midpoint or velocity requirement. Pointerup is sampled so a fast early release is not lost.
handedness.closed_motion: Lock dominant axis at6px travel (ties horizontal); maintain lock through curves and release. Horizontal axis changes side only after12px inward peak; vertical axis changes level only after24px peak. Landscape vertical docking is disabled. This current rule supersedes earlier independent two-axis diagonal docking.
handedness.open: Docking disabled; the shared menu controller handles vertical drags over the outlined trigger, gap and links. Stationary trigger tap closes. Horizontal open drags do not dock or accidentally close.
handedness.panel: Opposite side; mirrored labels face inward; Home remains level with trigger
handedness.tap_areas: 56px trigger and rows retained;12px dot unchanged
handedness.keyboard: Portrait Left/Right selects side and Up/Down steps height; closed landscape Up/Down cannot change height. Open menu arrows continue to scroll links.
handedness.safe_area: CSS/env geometry measured for all four endpoints; entire56px target stays on-screen, so very narrow/notched viewports can shift the nominal5%/95% center inward.
handedness.cancel: Real pointer cancellation/pinch abort restores original edge; a deliberate inward flick remains committed through a curved path or pause.

touch_capture: Touch implicitly captures on the touched element. Transfer to the shared root must ignore bubbled loss from the old child; only actual root capture loss cancels scrolling. Closed trigger similarly ignores loss from its inner dot when it takes capture.

orientation.landscape: Force bottom on current side at initialization and rotation; bypass stale drag-Y inline override in CSS, cancel active gesture/settle, release capture, suppress trailing click.
orientation.portrait: Six docks available again; retain current bottom/side when returning from landscape.
orientation.desktop: Existing mobile responsive test preserved; full desktop fixed links unchanged.

cardinal_settling: Normal releases ease along a single axis. If an interrupted prior glide leaves both coordinates off the new dock, native Web Animations applies two consecutive one-axis segments. New gestures/resize/rotation/destroy cancel stale work. Reduced motion (including live preference change) skips or ends animation. Without Web Animations, this uncommon two-coordinate correction commits immediately.
